_meta.scope: vendors, vendor_products, vendor_categories, vendor_attributes, vendor_orders, items_review, foods_review, booked_table
_meta.sources_searched: resources/views/**/*.blade.php, app/, routes/, public/js (non-min). All references are in Blade inline JS; app/Helpers/FirestoreHelper.php and public/js do not touch these collections.
_meta.missing_views: VendorController renders view('vendor.vendor'), view('vendor.categorylist'), view('vendor.list') (routes 'vendor', vendor category pages) but resources/views/vendor/ does NOT exist in this repo. The main multivendor storefront page is therefore absent; any extra vendor/product fields it used are not captured here.
_meta.type_legend: string|int|float|bool|timestamp|geopoint|map|array. 'number' notes mean the value is numeric but int vs float is not guaranteed. 'inferred': true = not referenced by web code, listed because it is a known eMart admin/mobile field and the migration should keep a column for it (verify against a real Firestore export).

title.shape: store name; client-side substring search in search.blade.php

description.shape: not read for vendors on web (description reads are advertisement docs)

coordinates.shape: GeoFirestore customKey geopoint; used implicitly by geoFirestore.near()

g.shape: {geohash:string, geopoint:geopoint}; GeoFirestore index used by near({center, radius})

author.shape: owner user id (users.id). Used to look up vendor user (fcm/email) and to filter vendors whose owner subscription is invalid

categoryID.shape: array<string> of vendor_categories ids; queried with array-contains

reviewsCount.shape: running count; written by browser on review submit

reviewsSum.shape: running sum of ratings; where reviewsSum >= 3 / > 4 (popular)

specialDiscount.shape: array<{day:string, timeslot:array<{from:string 'HH:mm', to:string 'HH:mm', discount:string|number, discount_type:'delivery'|'dinein', type:'percentage'|'amount'}>}>

adminCommission.shape: {commission:number|string, type:'fixed'|'percentage', enable?:bool}; overrides section adminCommision (sic) for price markup and order commission

restaurantCost.shape: cost for two (number or numeric string)

subscription_plan.shape: embedded plan snapshot: {orderLimit:string|int ('-1' = unlimited), itemLimit:string|int ('-1' = unlimited), ...other plan fields}

subscriptionTotalOrders.shape: remaining orders; parseInt'd so may be stored as string

vendors.pagination: limit(4|16|200|pagesize|BATCH_SIZE); startAfter(lastDoc).limit(pagesize) in allvendors/index:259, dinein/index:158, multivendor_home:802, footer:201 (batched full scan of section vendors for subscription validity). layouts/footer.blade.php:2169 does an UNBOUNDED collection('vendors').get() on every page using prices.
vendors.geo_usage: geoFirestore.collection('vendors').near({center: GeoPoint(address_lat,address_lng), radius: km}) combined with where section_id/zoneId/enabledDiveInFuture and limit (allvendors/index:109, dinein/index:87, home_page/multivendor_home:463,486,507, ecommerce_home:489, products/list:208, list_arrivals:83, dinein/dyiningvendor:596 hard-coded test center 23.397,70.652 r=200 whose result is discarded). Radius from sections.nearByRadius, converted miles->km when DriverNearBy.distanceType=='miles'.
vendors.writes: Only review aggregates: browser update({reviewsCount, reviewsSum}) on review submit/edit - my_order/completed_order.blade.php:617, :699. Everything else read-only from web (vendor docs come from admin/vendor panel).
vendors.access: public-read (store listing data). Writes must be server-side only: owner (author) for profile fields via vendor panel; reviewsCount/reviewsSum must be recomputed by the server from items_review, never accepted from the browser.
vendors.notes: SECURITY: any signed-in customer can overwrite another vendor's reviewsCount/reviewsSum (no ownership, read-modify-write race, edits subtract old rating client-side). Entire vendor doc (incl. adminCommission, subscription_plan, deliveryCharge) is embedded verbatim into vendor_orders.vendor and booked_table.vendor. Naming oddities: phonenumber (lowercase), enabledDiveInFuture, reststatus, categoryID is an ARRAY here but a STRING on vendor_products. reviewsCount/reviewsSum are compared to '' so may be '' in legacy docs - default 0. subscriptionTotalOrders/orderLimit/itemLimit numeric-or-string. MySQL: categoryID -> pivot table vendor_category (vendor_id, category_id); g/coordinates -> lat/lng DECIMAL + spatial POINT or geohash index; workingHours/specialDiscount -> JSON or child tables.

vendor_products.doc_id: Created outside the web app (admin/vendor panel). Doc id == field `id`. In cart/order flows a variant line uses composite id '<productId>PV<variant_id>' (split on 'PV' at checkout) - not a doc id.

id.shape: where id == / != ; orderBy('id') required by Firestore for the != query

price.shape: base price; parseFloat'd so may be stored as string

disPrice.shape: discount price; '' or '0' means none (string compare) - stored as string in practice

categoryID.shape: FK vendor_categories.id (single string, unlike vendors.categoryID array)

createdAt.shape: orderBy createdAt asc (item-limit cut-off for subscription plans, vendor product lists)

quantity.shape: stock; -1 (or '-1') = unlimited. Decremented by the browser at checkout

addOnsTitle.shape: array<string>; parallel to addOnsPrice by index

size.shape: array<string> size titles parallel to sizePrice (eMart admin)

item_attribute.shape: nullable. {attributes: array<{attribute_id:string (FK vendor_attributes.id), attribute_options:array<string>}>, variants: array<{variant_id:string, variant_sku:string ('opt1-opt2' joined by '-' in attribute order), variant_price:string|number, variant_quantity:string ('-1' = unlimited), variant_image:string url}>}

digitalProduct.shape: download URL shown after order completed

vendor_products.pagination: limit(4|5|200|itemLimit); startAfter(lastDoc) after orderBy createdAt asc (footer getUserItemLimit: products beyond the vendor plan's itemLimit are hidden). layouts/footer.blade.php:2174 fetchVendorPriceData does an UNBOUNDED collection('vendor_products').get() (plus all vendors) on product pages to compute commission-adjusted prices.
vendor_products.writes: Browser writes: (1) checkout inventory - checkout/checkout.blade.php:1458 update({'item_attribute.variants': new_variants}) (variant_quantity re-stringified) and :1472 update({quantity}); (2) review aggregates - my_order/completed_order.blade.php:659, :737 update({reviewsCount, reviewsSum, reviewAttributes}). Product creation is read-only from web (vendor/admin panel).
vendor_products.access: public-read where publish=true (and vendor subscription valid). Owner = vendors.author via vendorID for CRUD in vendor panel. Stock decrement and review aggregates must move server-side (in the order/review transaction).
vendor_products.notes: SECURITY: customers can arbitrarily set any product's quantity/variants/review stats; stock decrement is a non-transactional read-modify-write (oversell/race); checkout/success.blade.php (online-payment path) never calls manageInventory, so stock is only decremented for COD/wallet. Prices shown are computed client-side (price + vendor/section commission) - the server must recompute. Numeric fields are often strings: price, disPrice ('0'), quantity ('-1'), variant_quantity (always written back as string), variant_price, addOnsPrice. reviewAttributes reset to null when empty. Firestore 'id !=' query requires orderBy id first - in SQL just WHERE id <> ?.

vendor_categories.doc_id: Created outside the web app (admin). Doc id == field `id`.

review_attributes.shape: array<string> of review_attributes ids (used with where('id','in', ...) on review_attributes, max 10)

vendor_categories.pagination: limit(7) item categories, limit(5) homepage categories
vendor_categories.notes: Referenced by vendors.categoryID (array) and vendor_products.categoryID (string); order products[].category_id copies it. review_attributes -> pivot table category_review_attribute.

vendor_attributes.doc_id: Created outside the web app (admin). Doc id == field `id`.

author.shape: FULL users doc snapshot copied from the browser: {id, firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber, profilePictureURL, shippingAddress:array, fcmToken, wallet_amount, role, ...}. Queried as 'author.id' ==

vendor.shape: FULL vendors doc snapshot (see vendors). Read: id, title, photo, location, phonenumber, author

products.shape: array<{id:string (product id, PV suffix stripped), name:string, photo:string ('' if null), price:string (unit item price incl. variant price), discountPrice:string, quantity:int, vendorID:string, extras_price:string, extras:array<string addon titles>, size:string ('' if null), variant_info: null | {variant_id:string, variant_sku:string, variant_options:map<attributeTitle:string, option:string>, variant_price:float, variant_qty:float, variant_image:string}, category_id:string}>

address.shape: {address:string|null, addressAs:string|null, id:string|null, isDefault:bool|null, landmark:string|null, locality:string, location:{latitude:float, longitude:float}} - copied from users.shippingAddress[] or built from cookies

status.shape: set 'Order Placed' by browser. Later values (other apps): 'Order Accepted','Order Rejected','Order Cancelled','Driver Pending','Driver Accepted','Driver Rejected','Order Shipped','In Transit','Order Ongoing','Order Completed'

couponId.shape: key duplicated in checkout object literal

discount.shape: coupon discount amount (parseFloat; success page parseInt then parseFloat - truncates decimals)

taxSetting.shape: array<{country:string, enable:bool, id:string, tax:string|number, title:string, type:'percentage'|'fixed'}> copied from `tax` collection

takeAway.shape: also compared to 'true'/'false' strings in footer listener

driver.shape: READ-ONLY on web (set by driver app): {firstName, lastName, profilePictureURL, phoneNumber, carNumber, ...users doc}

estimatedTimeToPrepare.shape: READ-ONLY on web; 'HH:MM' set by vendor app

vendor_orders.pagination: onSnapshot(where author.id == uid) in layouts/footer.blade.php:1794 on EVERY page for status-change popups (needs push/poll replacement). No limit on my_order list.
vendor_orders.writes: Browser set() of the whole order: checkout/checkout.blade.php:2890 (COD/wallet; also updates users.wallet_amount and writes wallet doc client-side right after) and checkout/success.blade.php:167 (after online payment, from session order_json echoed into JS). No client updates afterwards; status changes come from vendor/driver apps.
vendor_orders.access: owner (authorID / author.id) for read; vendor (vendors.author via vendorID) and assigned driver for read/status updates; create must be a server endpoint.
vendor_orders.notes: SECURITY (critical): the browser decides products[].price, discount, specialDiscount, deliveryCharge, tip_amount, adminCommission(+Type), tax/taxSetting, couponId/couponCode, payment_method and status - all from editable hidden inputs/cookies. Order total is never stored; every page recomputes it from these values. Wallet payment is deducted client-side (users.wallet_amount = wallet_amount - total_pay). Order id is a predictable uniqid. author is a full copy of the user doc (PII incl. fcmToken/wallet). MySQL: products -> order_items child table (with variant_info/extras JSON), address -> columns or JSON, author/vendor snapshots -> author_id/vendor_id FKs plus optional JSON snapshot, index (author_id, section_id, created_at). Numeric money fields arrive as strings - cast to DECIMAL on migration.

items_review.doc_id: Client-generated Firestore auto id: database.collection('tmp').doc().id, stored again in field `Id` (capital I). Updates address .doc(itemReviewDoc.Id).

VendorId.shape: vendors.id for product reviews; provider user id for on-demand bookings; '' for worker reviews; absent for parcel/rental

productId.shape: vendor_products.id, or provider service id (my_booking). Absent for parcel/rental driver reviews

driverId.shape: driver/worker users.id for parcel/rental/on-demand worker reviews; '' otherwise

orderid.shape: vendor_orders.id | parcel_orders.id | rental_orders.id | provider_orders id (polymorphic, no type column)

photos.shape: array<string url> (Firebase Storage); not written by parcel/rental

profile.shape: reviewer avatar URL (only shown if it contains firebasestorage.googleapis.com)

createdAt.shape: serverTimestamp(); overwritten on every update (so it's really updatedAt)

items_review.pagination: where productId == .limit(5) then .startAfter(lastDoc).limit(5) (products/detail.blade.php:740/754, providersService/service.blade.php:228/243/846). No orderBy, so order = doc-id order.
items_review.writes: Browser set/update: my_order/completed_order.blade.php:594 (update) / :671 (set) product reviews; parcel/parcel_orders.blade.php:778/:827; rental/rental_orders.blade.php:256/:308; rental/rental_orders_detail.blade.php:801/:853; my_booking/completed_booking.blade.php:659/:670 (provider/worker). Each also rewrites aggregates on vendors / vendor_products / users / parcel_orders / rental_orders.
items_review.access: public-read (product/service review lists); create/update owner = CustomerId, and only for an order the customer owns that is completed. Aggregate recomputation server-side.
items_review.notes: Shared polymorphic review table for 4 verticals (store product, parcel driver, rental driver, on-demand provider+worker). SECURITY: no check that CustomerId == current user on update, no check the order is completed/owned, client can write any rating value and tamper aggregates on other entities. Inconsistent casing: Id/CustomerId/VendorId vs productId/driverId/orderid. Suggest columns: review_type enum, order_id, product_id, vendor_id, driver_id, customer_id; unique(order_id, product_id) and unique(order_id, driver_id).

foods_review.doc_id: Client-generated Firestore auto id: database.collection('tmp').doc().id (my_dinein/dinein.blade.php), duplicated in field `Id`.

createdAt.shape: NOT written by web set(); keep nullable column for docs from mobile app

foods_review.writes: Browser set(): my_dinein/dinein.blade.php:191. Does NOT update vendors.reviewsCount/reviewsSum.
foods_review.access: public-read; create owner = CustomerId, only for own booked_table with an accepted/past booking (server-side).
foods_review.notes: Same shape as items_review minus productId/driverId/reviewAttributes and without createdAt. No duplicate guard beyond hiding the button client-side. Could be merged into items_review with review_type='dinein'.

booked_table.doc_id: Client-generated Firestore auto id: database.collection('tmp').doc().id (dinein/dyiningvendor.blade.php:1145), duplicated in field `id`.

author.shape: FULL users doc snapshot; queried as 'author.id' ==; reads firstName, lastName, profilePictureURL

vendor.shape: FULL vendors doc snapshot; reads title, photo, location, phonenumber

date.shape: reservation datetime (Timestamp.fromDate(event_date + event_time)); where > / < now, orderBy desc

status.shape: browser sets 'Order Placed'; vendor app sets 'Order Accepted' | 'Order Rejected'

booked_table.pagination: onSnapshot(where author.id == uid) in layouts/footer.blade.php:1973 on every page (status popups).
booked_table.writes: Browser set(): dinein/dyiningvendor.blade.php:1177. No client updates.
booked_table.access: owner (authorID / author.id) read; vendor (vendors.author via vendorID) read + status update; create via server endpoint.
booked_table.notes: SECURITY: discount/discountType come from DOM text the user can edit; status set by client; author is a full user-doc copy (PII). totalGuest and discount stored as strings. No server validation of date window (UI limits to today+6 days) or of vendor dine-in enabled flag. MySQL index (author_id, date).
